title: Clear the disconnected computer’s view
responsibility: Clears the workspace’s remote project view and replaces a project address with the start address.

inputs.name: forgetRemote.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace to invalidate and clear, including project list, snapshot, entity, cached-view state, capabilities, selected project and pending target.

inputs.name: forgetRemote.notice
inputs.description: The error notice to show after clearing; defaults to an empty string.

outputs.name: forgetRemote
outputs.description: No return value. Invalidates pending work, empties the project list, clears displayed and selected content, disables change capabilities and sets the notice. If a browser address exists and is not the start address, replaces it with / without adding a history entry.
